visualAssessment.reviewScope: Regional1254 overview; candidate1024 overview; r04_c01 and r04_c02 at1254 original pixels. This is seasonal surface planning, not acceptance of all seams or neighbor edges.

existingRedGoldLanternPost.observation: Large saturated red freestanding lantern/post with gold central panel, gold rings and cap is already a strong Spring Festival accent. Retain its silhouette, ornament count, blank face, stone plinth and shadow. No extra lanterns, characters or tassels needed.

architectureAndBridge.observation: Visible architecture is a pale gray stone arched bridge and stone balustrade, with cream/gray adjoining wall; no separate building facade, wooden doors or roof beams are visible in this tile. Do not turn the stone bridge red or add invented architectural ornaments.

orangeSurface.observation: Short exposed orange cap/rail blocks above the southwest flowerbed wall, partly occluded by foliage, are the only compact optional recolor area observed. Their block joints and smooth beveled finish could be painted trim/coping; pure wood material is not established. Do not change texture into woodgrain or relabel the surrounding stone as wood.

visualAssessment.protected: All leaves, trunks, soil, cream/gray masonry, bridge openings and edges, paving seams, blue water, highlights, occlusions and cast-shadow shape/direction.

minimalEditRecommendation.reason: The existing red/gold lantern post already supplies the festival signal; geometry-preserving reuse is visually viable. If a small seasonal difference is wanted, restrict it to the one orange cap/rail region below.

regions.requestedSurfaceChange: Only existing visible orange cap/rail faces may become restrained red lacquer with fine warm-gold on existing bevels/joints; preserve the source material and lighting rather than inventing woodgrain, patterns, relief, trim thickness or objects.
regions.maskRequirements: Draw a precise surface mask after selected is frozen. The bbox is not the mask. Exclude every overlapping leaf, green edge, pale stone post/rail, soil, water and existing dark contact edge. Retain source shadows and highlights. Boundary transitions may stay inside the eligible surface; outside-mask pixels must remain byte-identical.
